title: Phase transition, sharp asymptotics and symmetry for critical quasilinear Hartree equations beyond $σ=2p$
summary: We establish the sharp asymptotic and symmetry theory for the critical quasilinear Hartree equation \[ -Δ_pu=\big(|x|^{-σ}*u^{p^*_σ}\big)u^{p^*_σ-1} \quad\text{in }\mathbb R^N, \qquad p^*_σ=\frac{p(2N-σ)}{2(N-p)}, \] in the complementary range $2p 1$, every nonnegative finite-energy weak solution is automatically locally bounded. Our proof provides a quasilinear regularity mechanism adapted to this complementary range, where the potential-theoretic route available for $σ\le2p$ breaks down.
